description: A repository class that manages transaction-related operations in a financial application, interfacing with a data access object (DAO) and providing methods for adding, updating, deleting, listing transactions, and calculating balances.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing an interface for transaction domain operations such as adding, updating, deleting, listing, and calculating balances.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Validates and persists a new transaction.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing transaction.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by its ID.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: computeBalance
methods.description: Calculates the current balance as total income minus total expenses.

methods.name: monthlySums
methods.description: Generates monthly aggregation sums categorized by transaction type.
